title: v2: offline transcriber (sherpa Parakeet) and utterance builder
description: Build the pieces of the final pass (goal 6): an offline transcriber that turns an audio slice into text, and pure logic that turns diarization turns into utterances to transcribe.
steps: Create `asr/OfflineTranscriber.kt`: `interface OfflineTranscriber : Closeable { fun transcribe(samples: FloatArray): String }` and `fun interface OfflineTranscriberFactory { fun create(): OfflineTranscriber }`.

Create `engine/sherpa/SherpaOfflineTranscriber.kt`: builds `OfflineRecognizer(assetManager = null, config = OfflineRecognizerConfig(featConfig = FeatureConfig(sampleRate = 16000, featureDim = 80), modelConfig = OfflineModelConfig(transducer = OfflineTransducerModelConfig(encoder = <abs>, decoder = <abs>, joiner = <abs>), tokens = <abs>, numThreads = n, provider = "cpu", modelType = "nemo_transducer"), decodingMethod = "greedy_search"))`. `transcribe`: `val stream = recognizer.createStream(); stream.acceptWaveform(samples, 16000); recognizer.decode(stream); val text = recognizer.getResult(stream).text; stream.release(); return text.trim()`. `close()` → `recognizer.release()`. Add `SherpaOfflineTranscriberFactory(store, settings)` (throws `IllegalStateException("Model not installed: asr-parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-int8")` if missing) and `offlineTranscriberFactory` in `AppContainer`.

Create `diarization/UtteranceBuilder.kt`: `data class Utterance(val startMs: Long, val endMs: Long, val rawSpeaker: Int)`, `object UtteranceBuilder { fun build(turns: List<SpeakerTurn>, mergeGapMs: Long = 500, minMs: Long = 300, maxMs: Long = 30_000): List<Utterance>; fun renumber(utterances: List<Utterance>): Map<Int, Int> }`. build: sort turns by start; merge consecutive turns of the same speaker when the gap ≤ mergeGapMs; drop results shorter than minMs; split any utterance longer than maxMs into `ceil(len / maxMs)` equal parts. renumber: raw speaker → 0, 1, … in order of first appearance.
Create `audio/SampleSlicer.kt`: `fun FloatArray.sliceMs(startMs: Long, endMs: Long): FloatArray` (16 samples per ms, clamped to bounds, empty array if start ≥ end).
acceptanceCriteria: Test: a turn of 200 ms is dropped; a 65 000 ms turn becomes 3 utterances of ≈21 667 ms covering the full span without gaps
Test: renumber gives first-appearing raw speaker index 0
Test: `sliceMs(1000, 2000)` on 3 s of audio returns 16 000 samples; out-of-range end is clamped
`source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug` exits 0
